summary.text: Generating a dialogue with 30-60 messages using Me, Maya, Leo labels while maintaining Oct14 context, time window, and established facts about Leo's cancellation and Maya's dairy avoidance.
Extending the dialogue with afternoon timing, dairy-free constraint, and Friday pizza commitment while keeping label voices consistent.
Adjusting the dialogue to remove Leo and keep Maya and Me at Mario's Pine at noon with a dairy-free note.

content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: never go back to workkkk
Me: crying suit guy forever
Leo: ugh okay so update on my end
Leo: just got pulled into a deployment thing for friday
Maya: nooo on lunch??
Leo: yeah like noon through afternoon, i can't get away
Me: damn that sucks
Leo: i know, so i can't make friday's pizza after all
Maya: ugh that's the worst timing
Me: yeah we were counting on you for parking circle commentary
Leo: lol i know, you'll have to survive without me
Maya: are you free at all later or just slammed all day?
Leo: slammed, my manager basically said don't move
Me: classic friday trap
Leo: you guys should still go tho, don't skip on my account
Maya: oh we are, i still need pizza after this week
Me: yeah i'm still in for noon at Mario's
Maya: same, meet out front still?
Me: yep i'll walk over
Leo: have a garlic knot in my honor or two
Maya: i would but i'm still avoiding dairy so knots are risky
Me: oh right, do they butter them?
Maya: yeah last time they were all buttery, my stomach died
Leo: oof yeah skip those then
Maya: i'll just do a marinara slice no cheese, keeps it safe
Me: that's actually smart, their crust is good plain anyway
Leo: and no salty olive bomb this time please
Maya: lol we learned our lesson
Me: seriously, extra salt for no reason
Leo: how's your laptop doing today btw, still frozen?
Maya: mine froze once this morning and i wanted to throw it
Me: mine was dragging through standup again
Leo: did the sacred restart ritual?
Maya: twice lol, IT still ghosting me
Me: three times for me yesterday, gave up
Leo: full toolkit fail
Maya: did you guys eat lunch yet or just me starving
Me: not yet, i have leftover pasta waiting
Leo: join the pasta loop
Maya: i'm doing soup and toast again when i get home
Me: grandma gang
Leo: hey it's cozy, i'm freezing at my desk
Maya: same, heavy jacket inside is crazy
Me: i never took mine off today
Leo: fall jacket uniform forever at this point
Maya: need tea after this coffee honestly
Leo: ooo get me the weird lemon one virtually
Me: chamomile for me please
Maya: one weird one for leo, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers even when i'm bailing on pizza
Maya: of course, you're still invited to virtual tea
Me: so friday just us two then?
Maya: yep, still noon?
Me: yeah that works",
  "writer_note": "Kept Leo's work conflict casual and clear while having Maya and Me confirm they're still on for Mario's, and wove in Maya avoiding dairy via buttery knots and a no-cheese plan amid normal tea, laptop, and jacket chatter."
}
